faq.title: Frequently asked questions
faq.subtitle: Everything you need to know before you arrive

questions.q1: Is there parking near the apartment?
questions.a1: There is no private parking in the building. The apartment is outside the city centre's restricted access zones, so parking nearby is easier than in the old town. To visit the centre (about 2 km away) we recommend bus, taxi or leaving the car in a city-centre car park.
questions.a2: We're sorry, pets are not allowed in the apartment to respect other guests and maintain cleanliness.
questions.a3: 24 hours before your arrival you will receive a WhatsApp message and email with the key safe code. No need to coordinate with anyone. You can arrive at any time between 16:00 and 23:00.
questions.a4: Yes. Before your arrival the apartment receives a full clean, including linen and towel change and bathroom items replenishment.
questions.a5: Yes, the apartment has air conditioning in all rooms (living room and bedrooms). Essential in summer when temperatures can exceed 40°C in Seville.
questions.a6: The apartment accommodates up to 4 guests: a double bedroom with a king bed and another bedroom with two single beds.
questions.a7: Of course! The apartment is suitable for children of all ages. A travel cot is available on request, just ask us.
questions.q8: Is there WiFi? Is it fast?
questions.a8: Yes, the apartment has high-speed fibre optic WiFi (600 Mbps). The network name and password are in the welcome book.
questions.q9: What are check-in and check-out times?
questions.a9: Check-in: from 16:00. Check-out: before 12:00. If your flight arrives earlier, you can leave your luggage for free and explore the city.
questions.q10: Does the apartment have a fully equipped kitchen?
questions.a10: Yes, the kitchen is fully equipped: fridge, hob, microwave, coffee maker (Nespresso capsules), toaster, kettle, full utensils and crockery for 4 people.
questions.q11: Is smoking allowed in the apartment?
questions.a11: Smoking is not allowed inside the apartment. Violation of this rule results in a €150 penalty.
questions.q12: How do I get from the airport?
questions.a12: The easiest option is the EA bus (Airport Express), running every 15-30 minutes for €4. Get off at Santa Justa (about 30-40 minutes) and from there the apartment is a 7-minute walk.
questions.q13: What if I have a problem during my stay?
questions.a13: We are available 24/7 via WhatsApp for any issue. In case of emergency: 112 is the emergency number in Spain.
questions.q14: Are stag/hen parties or events allowed?
questions.a14: Parties or events that could disturb neighbours are not allowed. Seville has many nightlife options, but the apartment is exclusively for rest.
questions.q15: Does the apartment have a lift?
questions.a15: Yes, the building has a lift.
questions.a16: Yes, the apartment has a washing machine with detergent included.
questions.q17: Can I check out late if my flight is in the afternoon?
questions.a17: Standard check-out is before 12:00. For later departures you can leave your luggage stored in the apartment.
questions.q18: Is the apartment adapted for people with reduced mobility?
questions.a18: The building has a lift. The apartment is on the 3rd floor. There is a step at the building entrance. If you have special needs, please consult us before booking.
questions.a19: When you confirm your booking you will receive a link to complete pre-check-in: passport details, estimated arrival time and preferences. This allows us to prepare everything for your arrival and comply with Spanish traveller registration regulations.
questions.q20: What is the apartment's tourist registration number?
questions.a20: Tourist registration number with the Junta de Andalucía: AT/SE/03584. You can verify it in the Andalusia Tourism Register.

p: We collect the following personal data:
list: Booking data: name, email, phone, stay dates, number of guests
Payment data: processed exclusively by Stripe (we do not store card details)
Pre-check-in: ID document details, date of birth, nationality (required by law)
Communications: chat or email messages sent through the site
Technical data: IP address, browser type, pages visited (via Google Analytics)
Booking management: performance of the contract (Art. 6.1.b GDPR)
Traveller registry: legal obligation, Organic Law 4/2015 on Public Safety (Art. 6.1.c GDPR)
Booking-related communications: performance of the contract
Marketing/newsletter: consent of the data subject (Art. 6.1.a GDPR)
Analytics: legitimate interest in improving the service

p: Your data may be disclosed to:
list: Security Forces (SES.HOSPEDERÍA): legal obligation
Stripe Inc.: payment processing (PCI-DSS certified)
Resend/SendGrid: transactional email delivery
Supabase: data storage (servers in the EU)
Google Analytics: anonymised data for traffic analysis
Booking data: 5 years (tax obligation)
Traveller registry data: 3 years (police regulations)
Communications data: up to 2 years after the last contact
